name: votesphere-fullstack
description: Secure Local Real-Time Voting & Rating System with React Frontend, Python Flask Backend, TOTP dynamic passcodes, and anti-cheat tab-switching protection.

scripts.postinstall: (pip install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || pip3 install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || pip install -r backend/requirements.txt) && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build: (pip install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || pip3 install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt || pip install -r backend/requirements.txt) && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
